subject: Pilot MPA: Meridian Retail - milestones, owners, decision criteria
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ethan.walker@meridianretail.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridianretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MPA: Meridian Retail - milestones, owners, decision criteria

Hi Ethan & Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared record and clear next steps.

Pain points you articulated:
- Catalog search returns are inconsistent across locations; high false positives for product matches when queries include colloquial terms.
- Peak-hour latency on the customer chat assistant spikes (1000–1500ms) and causes abandonment during holiday promos.
- Cost unpredictability when traffic bursts hit our current serving stack.

Goals we heard:
1) Reduce chat assistant p99 latency to under 350ms for common flows during peak periods.
2) Improve search relevance for merchandising queries by +12 NDCG on your benchmark prompts.
3) Put a predictable cost model in place for holiday bursts (target: <25% increase over baseline).

Proposed pilot scope (we sketched):
- 8-week pilot using Redwood Dedicated in us-west with a single-index search reranker + chat model for 1 storefront (pilot SKU set ~25k SKUs).
- Success metrics: p99 latency, search NDCG, and cost per 1M tokens.
- Stakeholders: Ethan (Meridian product lead), Priya (Meridian procurement), Lukas (Redwood AE), Grace (Redwood CS lead).

Milestone draft (attached as Meridian_MPA_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (by 9/19): Environment access, sample data snapshot, security questionnaire answer set (we'll share SOC2 artifacts).
- Week 2 (by 10/03): Baseline collection & first-model deployment to staging; initial latency report.
- Week 5 (by 10/24): Optimization pass (batching, KV cache), search reranker tuned on your prompts.
- Week 8 (by 11/14): Final evaluation, handoff plan, and procurement/contract decision.

Open questions we need from you to finalize the MPA:
1) Which internal stakeholder should be owner for procurement approvals (name & email)?
2) Do you have any blackout dates in Oct/Nov for deployments?
3) Are there specific compliance artifacts beyond SOC2 (e.g., regional data residency requirements)?

Next immediate steps (my recommended sequencing):
- Priya: confirm procurement owner & contract cadence by 9/16.
- Ethan: share a sample product feed (CSV, 25–50 examples) + 2 weeks of chat logs by 9/18.
- Grace: we’ll send a short onboarding doc + SOC2 snapshot by 9/16.

Attachments: Meridian_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA draft), Meridian_Security_Qs.pdf (initial security checklist answers).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0137

---
Note: files attached are stubs: Meridian_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA workbook, milestone and owner columns), Meridian_Security_Qs.pdf (summary answers, references SOC2 report link).

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridianretail.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Walker <ethan.walker@meridianretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MPA: Meridian Retail - milestones, owners, decision criteria

Thanks Lukas — solid recap. Quick answers and clarifications: 

Procurement owner: I will own procurement and contracts for the pilot (Priya Singh, priya.singh@meridianretail.com, +1 212 555 0199). I’ll loop in legal if we need changes to terms.

Blackout dates: We have a code freeze from Oct 29–Nov 3 and Thanksgiving week (Nov 26–30). Prefer no production-impacting work during those windows. Staging tests are fine.

Compliance: Meridian requires a short data retention note for EU-origin traffic; not applicable to the pilot storefront (US only) but worth documenting if we expand. SOC2 is sufficient for this initial pilot.

I'll send the sample feed + two weeks of chat logs by COB Thu (9/18).

One ask from our side: can Redwood commit to an internal escalation owner for any production incident during the pilot (weekend coverage?) — we’d like a single phone/contact.

Otherwise, agreed on milestones. Priya

--
Priya Singh
Head of Vendor Programs, Meridian Retail
priya.singh@meridianretail.com
+1 212 555 0199

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MPA: Meridian Retail - milestones, owners, decision criteria

Thanks Priya — welcome to the thread. Lukas — I’ll be the technical owner for the pilot on Redwood’s side. For your escalation ask, Priya, point of contact will be me during business hours (grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com) and our on-call rotation will cover nights/weekends; I’ll share the emergency contact card in the project folder before staging deploy.

Action items I’m taking:
- Update MPA worksheet with procurement contact and blackout dates (ETA 9/16 EOD).
- Share SOC2 redacted artifact + diagram of network egress for the Dedicated pool (link in drive).
- Draft runbook for incident triage for the pilot (will include RTO/RPO targets we discussed).

Note on data: To keep the pilot scoped and fast, we recommend a 25k SKU sample with anonymized identifiers — if you can flag PII fields we’ll avoid ingesting them into the staging store.

Grace

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Thanks all — short confirmation so we have the latest in-thread. I updated the attached MPA to reflect:
- Procurement owner = Priya Singh (contact added).
- Blackout windows noted (Oct 29–Nov 3, Nov 26–30).
- Grace listed as Redwood escalation owner (business hours + on-call details).
- Added a quick decision gate after Week 5: exec review to approve production rollout or scope a second optimization phase.

Next steps (final):
1) Priya to upload sample feed & logs by 9/18 (we’ll confirm receipt).
2) Grace to upload SOC2 snapshot & runbook link by 9/16.
3) I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with Meridian engineering and Redwood CS for Wed 9/24 (proposed 10:00 PT) — if that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

If there are no objections, this MPA becomes the working plan and we’ll treat the milestone dates as target commitments.

Thanks — I’ll send the invite after Priya confirms the feed timing.

Lukas
